summary: 60-foot International Derrick tower in Hardin County, Tennessee, run by the Division of Forestry; registered 2023 with no build date; cab roof and windows missing at 2023 visit.

events.note: Registered December 16, 2023 as US 1768, TN 70; nominated by Jason Johns
NHLR site visit dated 11/25/23 records the cab missing its roof and windows

evidence.supports: 60-foot International Derrick tower; cab missing roof and windows

evidence.supports: administered by Tennessee Division of Forestry
Bee Rock is a Hardin County tower on the Landforms list
most TDF towers built late 1940s to about 1960

evidence.supports: International Derrick Model 1933 and Aermotor MC-39 nearly identical
evidence.quote: Aermotor Model MC-39 and the International Derrick Model 1933 towers were nearly identical in design and construction

evidence.supports: Bee Rock listed under Hardin County

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register calls the tower Savannah and Landforms calls a Hardin County tower Bee Rock. The two are in the same county with elevations 10 feet apart, so they may be one structure, but no source says so directly.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers
sources.publisher: National Register of Historic Places multiple property document, National Park Service (npgallery.nps.gov)

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, reason for siting, staffing, fires or public access rule appears in any source we could read. The Savannah and Bee Rock names are linked by county and elevation only (774 ft NHLR vs 784 ft Landforms); please confirm they are one tower. The NPS study's table of extant towers as of March 26, 2014 (cite 3) lists Bee Rock, Olive Hill and Turkey Knob in Hardin County and names no Savannah tower. The Forest Lookouts Bee Rock page has no tower detail beyond the county heading. A Facebook group post (Fire Lookout Association-Tennessee) describes the tower as about 60 ft and in rough shape, but the page could not be read, so it is not used. The 2023 visit is the most recent record; the cab condition may have changed since.
